name: ashen-riffle-small-deck-decline-returns-all-four-revealed-cards
notes: Ashen Riffle (fjpimrl974), renamed from ashen-riffle-decline-returns-revealed-card (whose snapshot pinned the single-card reveal of the fixed-index loop bug). The deck holds only five cards: Noire (Suited ally), Noire, Fluffy Shopkeep, Fairy Whispers, Fairy Whispers. Declining the optional banish (PASS) must put all FOUR revealed cards on the bottom in their original order, BEHIND the one unrevealed card, which stays on top (the dontSkipOnPass regression of 1ea25c27 and the reveal-loop bug both covered).

rulesClauses: Reveal the top four cards of your deck. Banish up to two Suited non-action cards revealed this way and put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Two defects. (1) AshenRiffleStart() revealed the top four cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped -- only the top card was ever revealed (live repro on HEAD: the Suited cards in slots 2-4 stayed on top of the deck, never offered, and only the top card went to the bottom). Fixed with the new MZMoveTopOfZone() helper. (2) After banishing the first Suited card, AshenRiffleChoose built the second prompt before the banished card's slot was spliced out of myTempZone, so the prompt listed stale myTempZone-N slots (the banished card's removed phantom shifts every later index by one once the zone is cleaned up): fixed by CleanupRemovedCards() before re-offering. The dontSkipOnPass on the pick handler was already fixed in 1ea25c27.
